name: Algol68C
reason: The exact archive section leads with Birrell’s compiler account, but lists a separate Algol68C Reference Manual. In TR6 §2.1 printed page 8 Birrell expressly calls Algol68C a language after the renaming of Z70 and separately describes a new portable Algol68C compiler. The original bare anchor keeps both plausible. The compiler-specific claim remains supported.
